oracle.statement: GET /collections returns HTTP 200 and result.collections is a JSON array whose every entry (global, siblings included) is a well-formed {name: non-empty string} CollectionDescription; before any setup the unique prefix scope is empty, and after creating 3 prefix-owned collections each appears exactly once, byte-identical to its create-request name - non-200 on the legal GET = Type1_IllegalRejection, missing/unparseable array or malformed entry = Type4_StateLogicViolation, missing/duplicate/mutated prefix-scoped name = Type4_StateLogicViolation; 5xx with /healthz alive = Type3; transport failure with healthy /healthz or create setup failure = SCRIPT_ERROR
